name_zh: 任正非/华为/狼性文化/备胎计划/5G/芯片自主/以客户为中心
name_en: Ren Zhengfei/Huawei/Wolf Culture/Backup Plan/5G/Chip Independence/Customer Centric
description_zh: 任正非 (1944-) 华为创始人，"狼性文化" 锻造极致奋斗组织，"备胎计划" 提前十年布局芯片/操作系统/数据库自主可控，5G 专利全球领跑引领通信标准，"以客户为中心" 重构价值链，从军工转型为全球 ICT 基础设施领袖，面对美国制裁展现极致生存韧性。
description_en: Ren Zhengfei (1944-) Huawei founder, wolf culture forged extreme striving organization, backup plan decade-early laid out chip/OS/database self-sufficiency, 5G patents global leadership shaping telecom standards, customer-centric restructured value chain, transformed from military-industrial to global ICT infrastructure leader, demonstrated extreme survival resilience under US sanctions.
reason_zh: 任正非代表军工技术人员如何通过极致组织建设与战略前瞻构建全球科技巨头，展示了"备胎计划" 如何将生存焦虑转化为战略储备，其狼性文化/以客户为中心/备胎计划三位一体模式成为中国科技企业全球突围范式。
reason_en: Ren represents how military technician builds global tech giant through extreme organizational building and strategic foresight, demonstrating how backup plan transforms survival anxiety into strategic reserve, his wolf culture/customer-centric/backup plan trinity becoming Chinese tech enterprise global breakout paradigm.
